name: Bishop's Stortford Spring - British Blind Off 2023

venue.name: Birchwood High School
venue.address: Parsonage Lane, Bishop's Stortford, Hertfordshire, CM23 5BD

information:
**PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. We will be holding Clock, Square-1 and Megaminx in addition, but we still regard this as a blindfolded specialist competition.

The winner of 3x3 Blindfolded will be announced as the winner of the competition.
